title: Herdr support and /cloud session moves
highlights: jcode is now a first-class agent in herdr: its name and working/idle state show in the sidebar and herdr agent list, herdr agent wait works on it, and after a herdr restart the pane reopens the same jcode session
/cloud and /local move a live session, including uncommitted code, to a cloud host and back
improvements: herdr reports run in the background with a short timeout, so herdr can never slow jcode down, and jcode releases the pane when you quit
fixes: Usage telemetry now counts tokens from responses that fail mid-stream, crashed sessions, compaction, and background agents
